why_trace.root_cause: The public source contract manifest still points at the pre-0.4.0 CLI and package source hashes, so the repository push gate cannot distinguish a current release from stale evidence.
evidence: GitHub main is tagged v0.4.0 while the manifest source_commit is 53f89d3e2a6c22c676691d4cc7e06ce74cc28ff5
data-truth source hashes for src/chatlens/cli.py and src/chatlens/__init__.py do not match the current committed blobs
Reanchoring keeps the existing data path, fact, and documentation inventory while binding it to the exact release head
